verdict.rationale: A public company-register portal could plausibly offer a versioned API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web search screens, a publication platform, and structured data downloads described as a non-binding service. Nothing documents a versioned API, versioning scheme or deprecation policy, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
